name: wextend
expr: ys = wextend(1, 'sym', x, 2); ysw = wextend(1, 'symw', x, 2); ya = wextend(1, 'asym', x, 2); yaw = wextend(1, 'asymw', x, 2); y0 = wextend(1, 'sp0', x, 2); y1 = wextend(1, 'sp1', x, 2); yp = wextend(1, 'per', x, 2); yz = wextend(1, 'zpd', x, 2); yd = wextend(1, 'ppd', x, 2); M2z = wextend(2, 'zpd', M, 1); M2s = wextend(2, 'sym', M, 1); Mar = wextend('ar', 'zpd', M, 1); Mac = wextend('ac', 'zpd', M, 1); ylocL = wextend(1, 'sym', x, 2, 'l'); ylocR = wextend(1, 'sym', x, 2, 'r'); ylocN = wextend(1, 'sym', x, 2, 'n'); ylocU = wextend(1, 'sym', x, 2, 'u'); yspd = wextend(1, 'spd', x, 2); yi16 = wextend(1, 'sym', int16(x), 2); yu8 = wextend(1, 'sp0', uint8(x), 2); ycz = wextend(1, 'sym', [1+2i 3 4], 1); Mlf2 = wextend(2, 'sym', M, [1 2]);
comment: Sig: y = wextend(type, mode, x, lf[, side]). Bug fix 2026-05-08: extended modes (symw, asym, asymw, sp0, sp1) and 2-D forms (type=2 / 'ar' / 'ac') were not implemented. Now full coverage: 11 modes × 4 type forms × 3 sides. tol=0 (integer-stable on integer inputs). Argcheck portion 2026-09-19: x in {double, single, integer classes} + complex (logical/char reject); LOC letters l/u = start, r/d = end, n = unchanged, anything else = both; 'spd' is the reference's alias of sp1; 2-element lf extends rows/cols by different amounts on the 2-D forms; the result keeps x's class.
